title: 第29章 凝聚虚丹手感不错第30章 潜龙榜第一名动学院
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 一次炼丹失败根本不算什么。
等到潜龙爭夺战结束，他要进入东荒学院看看，是否有著修炼火焰的功法，兑换一门。
没有离开深谷。
苏辰想要继续碰碰运气，看看是否能够寻找到其他顶级灵草。
继续深入，山谷的最深处笼罩著一层薄薄的红雾，看上去诡异无比。
『难道因为这里的异动，才使得深谷没有任何声音』
苏辰也只是猜测而已。
此时。
紫狐从苏辰的怀里窜出，朝著面前的红雾点著头。
“你想进去？”
紫狐的伤势已经稳定下来，不过想要彻底恢復，恐怕最少也需要数月时间，甚至是数年时间。
他也能够隱约间猜到，紫狐的等级应该很高，否则的话，之前在天骨城，白狐也不会直接给紫狐下跪。
“那你去吧。”
紫狐摇摇头，吱吱地叫著。
“让我跟你去？”
看著紫狐点头，苏辰很是无奈，没有办法，既然紫狐都已经开口，他总不能拒绝紫狐。
抱著紫狐，苏辰直接朝著面前红雾走去。
红雾笼罩，苏辰没有丝毫的阻碍便顺利走了进去，立刻感受到红雾气息，源源不断地入侵脑海，狠狠地侵蚀著灵魂。
心中大惊，苏辰立刻运转混沌吞噬诀，一股股的吞噬力量，在身体四周形成吞噬气罩，来抵挡红雾气息的侵蚀。
继续往前走。
“妖兽尸体。”
看著面前的庞大尸体，苏辰眼神顿时一凝，一具尸体能够威慑深谷如此安静，看来这位妖兽生前应该很强。
紫狐瞬间窜了出去，直接来到尸体上，开始吞噬起来。
无奈耸耸肩，苏辰也没有阻止，紫狐吞噬尸体的力量，相信一定是能够承受，他没有必要阻止紫狐吞噬。
苏辰也盘膝而坐，他能够感受到这里，虽然红雾气息会侵蚀灵魂，不过对於他来说，未必是一件坏事。
他拥有著混沌吞噬诀，可以吞噬红雾气息，转化成自己的力量来修炼。
如今的他，已经顺利突破到巔峰筑基境，距离虚丹境也只是相差最后一步，希望能够藉助这里的力量，一举顺利突破到虚丹境。
盘膝而坐，体內运转的混沌吞噬诀，开始爆发出一股股的吞噬气息。
笼罩著全身各处。
吞！
疯狂的吞噬四周的红雾。
正在吞噬尸体力量的紫狐，看到苏辰正在修炼，两只漂亮的眼睛咕嚕嚕地转著，似乎在思考著什么。
最终的紫狐还是选择相助苏辰。
將尸体吞噬的力量，化作一股出来，朝著苏辰奔腾而去。
content_en:
A failure in alchemy is nothing at all.
When the battle for the Hidden Dragon is over, he will enter Donghuang Academy to see if there is a method for cultivating flames and exchange it for one.
Did not leave the deep valley.
Su Chen wanted to continue to try his luck to see if he could find other top-level spiritual herbs.
Continuing deeper, the deepest part of the valley is shrouded in a thin layer of red mist, which looks extremely strange.
"Is it because of the strange movement here that there is no sound in the deep valley?"
Su Chen was just guessing.
at this time.
The purple fox jumped out of Su Chen's arms and nodded towards the red mist in front of him.
"You want to go in?"
Zihu's injury has stabilized, but it may take at least several months, or even years, to fully recover.
He could also vaguely guess that Zihu's level should be very high, otherwise, in Tiangu City before, White Fox would not kneel down to Zihu directly.
"Then go ahead."
Zihu shook his head and squeaked.
"Want me to go with you?"
Seeing Zihu nodding, Su Chen was helpless. He had no choice. Since Zihu had already spoken, he couldn't refuse Zihu.
Holding Zihu in his arms, Su Chen walked directly towards the red mist in front of him.
The red mist shrouded Su Chen and he walked in smoothly without any hindrance. He immediately felt the aura of red mist, continuously invading his mind and eroding his soul.
Shocked in his heart, Su Chen immediately used the Chaos Devouring Technique. The devouring power formed a devouring air shield around his body to resist the erosion of the red mist.
Keep going.
"Demon corpse."
Looking at the huge corpse in front of him, Su Chen's eyes suddenly froze. A corpse can intimidate the deep valley to be so quiet. It seems that this monster must have been very strong during his lifetime.
The purple fox rushed out in an instant, came directly to the corpse, and began to devour it.
Su Chen shrugged helplessly, and Su Chen did not stop him. I believe the purple fox must be able to withstand the power of devouring the corpse. There was no need for him to stop the purple fox from devouring the body.
Su Chen also sat cross-legged. He could feel this. Although the red mist breath would corrode the soul, it was not necessarily a bad thing for him.
He possesses the Chaos Devouring Technique, which can swallow the breath of red mist and turn it into his own power for practice.
Now, he has successfully broken through to the peak foundation-building realm, and is only the last step away from the virtual core realm. He hopes to use the power here to successfully break through to the virtual core realm in one fell swoop.
Sitting cross-legged, the Chaos Devouring Technique running in his body began to emit waves of devouring aura.
Covering every part of the body.
swallow!
Crazy swallowing of the surrounding red mist.
Zihu, who was devouring the power of the corpse, saw Su Chen practicing, his two beautiful eyes turning gurglingly, as if he was thinking about something.
In the end, Zihu chose to help Su Chen.
The power that devoured the corpse turned into a force and rushed towards Su Chen.
